No new props, facial blendshapes, lip sync, cloth dynamics, or hair dynamics are included in this plan.
reason: The request is supported as a single stylized furry character with one authored dance action that can be expressed through modest whole-body travel and readable limb/head articulation.

states.meaning: A cheerful four-second toy dance with three clear alternating side-to-side beats, small whole-body hops, gentle coordinated arm swings, and head tilts, ending back in the neutral starting pose.

requirements.description: The full character performs three clearly readable alternating side-to-side beats over the clip with small bounded lateral travel and returns to the original centered neutral pose by the end.
The full character shows a cheerful dance rhythm across the clip, with the side-to-side beats and hops reading as coordinated repeated movement rather than a single gesture.
Both arms swing gently in coordination with the dance, visibly moving relative to the torso rather than remaining fixed while the body translates.
The head tilts in coordination with the dance beats, visibly moving relative to the torso rather than only following whole-body travel.
The feet perform small readable hops, including brief lifts from the ground plane as part of the dance, without introducing props or external interactions.
